summary: Ansible can always be installed from PyPI with pip; distribution packages are maintained by their communities, and only pip instructions are maintained by Ansible.
questions: Who maintains the distro packages for Ansible?
Where do I report a bug in my distro's Ansible package?

answer_card.title: Distro packages vs pip
answer_card.answer_md: Ansible itself only maintains the `pip install` instructions. Distribution packages are maintained by each distro's community, so report packaging bugs to that community.
